release_condition: Actual source availability and native feature/entropy/causality/off-path qualification required. Profiling actual calculation AND ordinary notes must project completion within the fixed cap. If not, no science launch or batch/policy sweep.
limits: Old latency proxy, not measured feature-export/ordinary-note/concurrency performance.
All-cap writer projection uses one existing128-action example. It is a planning scenario, not a runtime guarantee.
No pretrained-model or experiment-head call performed. Bound includes future qualification and scientific work; no new instance/capacity/stack.
Existing four-workers-per-reserved-chip accounting must be rechecked on actual proposed core mapping before release.
Assigned physical-chip-equivalent hours, not billed instance hours/dollars. CPU source preparation and head fitting are accounted separately.
context_allocation: All three frozen prediction roles on all TRAIN and both DEV strata. The ordinary raw-ensemble table is available without a second selective extraction.

actual_profile_rule.qualification: 32 separate sources,16 calculation and16 ordinary; four native workers on one existing chip, all three prediction roles; no scientific DEV outcomes.
actual_profile_rule.writer_cap128_seconds: Maximum group_seconds*128/decode_iterations among original qualification greedy attempts after the first two per worker, including both source strata. Project every science note at that maximum128-action rate. No policy/cap/timing sweep.
actual_profile_rule.reader_seconds_per_context: Maximum science_path_seconds/documents over second and subsequent qualification native batches across all roles/workers. Full-vocabulary witness forwards are excluded from this measurement but actual qualification allocation is counted.
actual_profile_rule.projection: writer_cap128_seconds*13312/(4*3600) + 2*reader_seconds_per_context*40960/(4*3600) + .75 reserved physical-chip-equivalent hours for qualification/startup. Require <=8 total; qualification itself<=.5. Actual supervisor also enforces the hard ceiling. No runtime guarantee from projection.
actual_profile_rule.geometry: Read-only neuron-ls reports four logical cores per existing physical device under LNC2. Recheck unoccupied cores32..35 for qualification; cores32..39 maximum for science. No new capacity.
actual_profile_rule.qualification_accounting: Whole one-physical-chip wall time for each of five native stages: G1generation, B0features,Trawfeatures,Tnotefeatures,causality. Count idle assigned cores and stragglers. CPU reference intervals without an active reservation are separate. Science counts whole two-chip phase wall time (one chip for secondary controls), including startup and physical closure.
